call_points.text: De-bottlenecking of MPP capacity at Dahej was commissioned in September 2026.
Phase II cGMP4 capex of ₹125 Cr is on track to operationalize by end Q4 FY27.
CDMO revenue on track to reach $100 million target in FY27.
Full-year FY27 EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 30% (+/- 1-2%).
R32 HFC expansion (15,000 MTPA) and Dahej MPP debottlenecking targeted for Q3FY27 commissioning.
Chemours project on track for completion end June or early July 2026.
Employee expense growth modeled at 7.5% to 9% following cost optimization.
Net working capital guidance improved to 75-80 days of sales.
Specialty Chemicals vertical has order visibility for up to 80% capacity utilization in FY27.
Management actively monitoring volatile Middle East situation and raw material inflation.

operating_notes.text: Net working capital improved to 74 days in FY26, guided at 75-80 days going forward.
CDMO working on 50-60 active molecules, split evenly between early-stage and late-stage commercial.
HPP revenue growth was led by volume and higher realisations, with a constructive HFC pricing environment.
CDMO order book supports momentum, with deeper engagement with a European CDMO major.
Total R&D spend in FY2025-26 was ₹48.71 Cr.

Navin Fluorine Advanced Sciences Limited amended its HFO contract with Solstice Advanced Materials US, Inc., extending tenure to December 2032 and adding ~$180M in revenue potential for a total of ~$590M.
De-bottlenecking MPP capacity at Dahej commissioned in September 2026.
R32 HFC capex of ₹236.5 Cr has peak revenue potential of ₹600-825 Cr per annum.
Solar-wind hybrid plant of 14.9 MW being set up via SPV with ₹15.73 Cr investment to meet >60% energy needs.

timeline.summary: Navin Fluorine reported its annual audited financial results for FY26, recommended a final dividend of ₹8.60 per share, and approved key leadership re-appointments.
Navin Fluorine reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,314 Cr, up 41% YoY, and PAT of ₹664 Cr, up 130% YoY.
Navin Fluorine reported Q4 FY26 earnings call details, highlighting 41% YoY FY26 revenue growth and $100M CDMO guidance for FY27.
Navin Fluorine amended its long-term HFO supply contract with Solstice Advanced Materials US, Inc. to December 2032, adding ~$180 million in revenue potential.
Board of Directors declared an interim dividend of ₹8 per equity share for FY 2026-27, record date November 5, 2026, payable on or after November 26, 2026.
Navin Fluorine reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,190.74 Cr (+57% YoY) and EBITDA margin of 34.22%, with Dahej MPP debottlenecking commissioned.
